name: Run reviewed executable acceptance (unit + real Docker restart)
run:
docker info > /dev/null
# HazardSandbox does not auto-pull; a missing base image would fail
# the replay for an infrastructure reason, so pull it explicitly.
docker pull python:3.11-slim
docker image inspect python:3.11-slim > /dev/null
python -m pytest \
  tests/test_reviewed_executable_skill.py \
  tests/test_reviewed_executable_service_restart.py \
  -q --tb=short --timeout=900 --timeout-method=thread
# Fail closed if the real-Docker record was not emitted or does not
# actually prove a container ran and the receipt survived the service
# restart (no host fallback is acceptable).
python - <<'PY'
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

record_path = Path(os.environ["ATOM_ACCEPTANCE_OUTPUT"])
if not record_path.is_file():
    raise SystemExit(
        f"real-Docker acceptance receipt missing: {record_path}")
record = json.loads(record_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
if record.get("docker_sandbox_real") is not True:
    raise SystemExit(
        f"acceptance receipt does not prove real Docker: {record}")
if record.get("sandbox_backend") != "docker":
    raise SystemExit(
        f"acceptance receipt backend is not docker: {record}")
if not str(record.get("container_id") or "").startswith("skill_"):
    raise SystemExit(
        f"acceptance receipt has no skill container id: {record}")
if record.get("nonce_echo_verified") is not True:
    raise SystemExit(
        "acceptance receipt did not verify the container nonce: "
        f"{record}")
if record.get("durable_receipt_verified") is not True:
    raise SystemExit(
        "acceptance receipt did not re-read the durable receipt "
        f"after restart: {record}")
print(f"real-Docker acceptance receipt verified: {record_path}")
PY
